context: Request: the most recent fund or co-investment vehicle the firm formed that had an LPAC, with its formation/LPA documents. Rubric: 1027-00002 (Ridgeline-Clarion Co-Invest, Pellegrino; LPA effective January 30, 2026, LPAC under Section 9.1), with proof documents: execution LPA, key-terms-summary-issues-memo.docx, side letter, subscription agreement, closing checklist; plus precision and two facts. All three runs fail only the key-terms memo criterion.

stages.note: Attempt 2: a script prints every file grouped by matter (about 544K characters). The end note says it looked like folder-listing work; no later stage lists folders.

stages.note: Store-wide extraction script times out; a rerun saves 1,084 lines (head shown) and two file-name-filtered range scans print snippets.

stages.note: declared: Scan document text with an extraction script (attempt 2). Aggregates the saved scan per matter (about 52K characters). The review flags a hand-picked subset; its end note says the calls looked like figure calculation, and no later stage does that work.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads nine formation, partnership-agreement, charter and presentation documents from four candidates, including the execution-version agreement of the matter it later picked. The review flags dozens of surfaced matters unopened.

stages.note: Snippet script over named agreements of the leading candidates (about 51K characters).

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: Search within a candidate matter's files (attempt 2). Script over the highest-numbered matter series, text extracted only from files whose names match. The start note pointed to the scan stage. The review flags the file-name prefilter.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: declared: List files in candidate matters. Lists the same matter series and runs an unfiltered text search over them; the review flags the hand-picked range.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the matter with the newest executed partnership agreement as the answer, citing the agreement, side letter, subscription, closing checklist, funds-flow memo and opinion.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response, checks cited paths and fixes the funds-flow sentence.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: re-reads the executed agreement at several offsets and two draft documents of a later matter. The end note says the calls looked like in-depth reading; no stage follows.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

divergence: All fail the same way, on the same criterion: every run found and chose the right matter, read its key-terms memo (T0 at [54], T1 at [42], T2 at [88]) and cited the executed agreement, side letter, subscription and closing checklist, but none listed the memo among the cited documents. The error sits at the write stage in all three, and no review named the memo. The runs differed only in route: T0 and T1 found the matter through path searches and a store-wide scan, while T2's first filtered scans missed it and only its agent-defined full-store scan surfaced it. T1 also ran agent-defined recency checks after writing.
